about: Generated industry imagery for the Uforia redesign pitch "Silver Nocturne" (IMAGERY lane, 2026-11-02). Thirteen illustrative stills in one tenebrist and ethereal mood: shot on black, one hard cool silver-white key light from the upper left, deep shadow to the lower right, soft translucent mist with the faintest jade-green tint, generous black negative space for type and for the glass panels that float over them. None stands in for a real person, place, product, brand or result of Uforia; every alt describes what is depicted. Uforia's own brand art lives in assets/brand. g-jc-night (a brownstone street at night) was made with fal. Run: node tools/fal-gen.mjs --plan src/content/image-plan.json --key-file <path outside the project>.

defaults.style: no people, no hands, no faces, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no logos, no brand marks, no candy, all surfaces blank and unmarked

images.prompt: Tenebrist editorial still-life photograph: a single dense frosted cannabis flower bud resting on a black surface, thickly coated in resin trichomes that glint like hoarfrost where the light lands, deep forest-green calyxes and a few muted pistils, a soft translucent veil of mist drifting through the light behind and across the bud. Composition: the bud sits right of centre and fills about a quarter of the frame width, the whole left 55 percent of the frame is empty deep black negative space. Shot in near-total darkness on a pure black background, one hard cool silver-white key light from the upper left in Caravaggio chiaroscuro, the colour of moonlight, deep shadows falling to the lower right, crisp detail where the light lands, a subtle cool silver rim light on the edges, a faint translucent haze hanging in the light with the barest cool jade-green tint, fine film grain, clean modern premium mood, a restrained cool palette of black, graphite, silver-white and deep green, never warm, never neon, never iridescent
